@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+"""Collect plugin attributes for diagnostic display."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.compat import safe_getattr
+
+
+# groundwork: allow-duplicate maps many attribute names by delegating each lookup to safe_getattr
+def plugin_metadata(
+    plugin: object, names: Iterable[str], default: Any = None
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return a dict mapping each of ``names`` to the attribute of ``plugin``.
+
+    Attributes which are missing, or whose access raises an ``Exception`` or a
+    pytest outcome exception, are reported as ``default``. Other
+    ``BaseException`` subclasses (e.g. ``KeyboardInterrupt``) propagate.
+    """
+    return {name: safe_getattr(plugin, name, default) for name in names}
diff --git a/testing/test_plugin_metadata.py b/testing/test_plugin_metadata.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..3c6389b16
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_plugin_metadata.py
@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from _pytest.outcomes import fail
+from _pytest.outcomes import skip
+from _pytest.plugin_metadata import plugin_metadata
+import pytest
+
+
+class Plugin:
+    name = "myplugin"
+    version = ""
+    enabled = False
+    count = 0
+    items: list[str] = []
+
+    @property
+    def broken(self) -> str:
+        raise ValueError("boom")
+
+    @property
+    def skipped(self) -> str:
+        skip("nope")
+
+    @property
+    def failed(self) -> str:
+        fail("nope")
+
+    @property
+    def interrupted(self) -> str:
+        raise KeyboardInterrupt
+
+
+def test_no_names() -> None:
+    assert plugin_metadata(Plugin(), []) == {}
+
+
+def test_present_and_falsey_values_kept() -> None:
+    names = ["name", "version", "enabled", "count", "items"]
+    assert plugin_metadata(Plugin(), names, default="?") == {
+        "name": "myplugin",
+        "version": "",
+        "enabled": False,
+        "count": 0,
+        "items": [],
+    }
+
+
+def test_missing_and_raising_use_default() -> None:
+    names = ["missing", "broken", "skipped", "failed"]
+    assert plugin_metadata(Plugin(), names) == dict.fromkeys(names)
+    assert plugin_metadata(Plugin(), names, default="n/a") == dict.fromkeys(
+        names, "n/a"
+    )
+
+
+def test_accepts_iterable_of_names() -> None:
+    assert plugin_metadata(Plugin(), iter(["name"])) == {"name": "myplugin"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("exc", [KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit])
+def test_base_exceptions_propagate(exc: type[BaseException]) -> None:
+    class P:
+        @property
+        def attr(self) -> None:
+            raise exc
+
+    with pytest.raises(exc):
+        plugin_metadata(P(), ["attr"])
+    with pytest.raises(KeyboardInterrupt):
+        plugin_metadata(Plugin(), ["name", "interrupted"])
decisions: NEW because plugin_metadata: no existing helper maps a list of attribute names to a dict; it delegates each lookup to safe_getattr (allow-duplicate comment added for gw check WARN)
